_: Artifacts area: the document workspace pane (ArtifactWorkspace) and the source-control file preview (FileContentViewer).
ArtifactWorkspace.Unavailable: This document is unavailable or has not been shared with you.
ArtifactWorkspace.RevisionUnavailable: The linked revision is unavailable. No decision can be made from this view.
ArtifactWorkspace.HistoricalRevision: This is a historical revision. A different revision is now awaiting review.
ArtifactWorkspace.ShowingRevision: Showing revision {number}. The latest draft is revision {latest}.
_ArtifactWorkspace.PreviewCaption: {status} is either the 'Saved evidence' label or the raw revision status.
ArtifactWorkspace.Evidence.Intro: Earlier QA command results were saved so the team can recover after an interruption. No action is needed from you.
ArtifactWorkspace.Evidence.Note: These logs support further testing. They do not mean QA passed.
ArtifactWorkspace.NoRevisions: No earlier revisions. Saved changes will appear here.
ArtifactWorkspace.DecisionHelp: Approving makes this the reviewed version your team can use. Requesting changes sends it back to the author for revision.
ArtifactWorkspace.DecisionCommentPlaceho: Optional for approval; required when requesting changes
ArtifactWorkspace.Error.LoadFailed: The document could not be loaded. Close it and try again.
ArtifactWorkspace.AccessRequestJustifica: I need access to this linked document.
ArtifactWorkspace.AccessRequestSubmitted: Access request submitted for an Owner or Manager to review.
ArtifactWorkspace.Error.FeedbackRequired: Feedback is required when requesting a revision.
ArtifactWorkspace.Error.NoLongerAwaiting: This revision is no longer awaiting your decision. Review its current status before continuing.
ArtifactWorkspace.Error.InvalidSubjectId: Enter a valid employee or installation ID.
ArtifactWorkspace.Error.DecisionForbidde: You no longer have permission to decide this revision.
ArtifactWorkspace.Error.DecisionNotFound: This document or revision is no longer available.
ArtifactWorkspace.Error.DecisionConflict: This revision changed or was already decided. Close and reopen the document to review its current status.
ArtifactWorkspace.Error.DecisionFailed: The decision could not be saved. Try again or reopen the document to check its status.
_dynamic: ArtifactWorkspace.Status.* resolved from document status names (unknown statuses fall back to the raw value).
